capabilities: Arrange media and text in side-by-side layout blocks
Resize columns, rows and whole blocks by dragging
Float blocks so surrounding text wraps around them
Add captions and cross-references with automatic numbering
Store layouts as plain Markdown inside HTML comments
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0+ (1.6.0+ for the table context menu); supports desktop and mobile. No telemetry; remote media and web embeds load directly from their source URLs.
problem: Obsidian stacks embeds vertically and gives no way to place media side by side, resize them, or wrap text around them without leaving notes unreadable.

relations.evidence: local Excalidraw drawings (requires the Excalidraw plugin)

summary: Layout plugin that arranges images, videos, text and embeds side by side with drag-to-resize, stored as plain Markdown inside HTML comments.
